lines.en: I climb sideways along the trunk.
I stop each step, head turning first.

lines.zh: 我从一片叶子跳到另一片。
lines.en: I leap from leaf to leaf.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在后面轻轻地摆。
lines.en: My tail sways gently behind.
I slip under the vine.
I walk on the underside of a branch.
My foot slips and catches again.
The jungle is wet everywhere.

lines.zh: 我停下来，眼珠转了一圈。
lines.en: I stop and roll my eyes.
I climb slowly down the tree.
I poke my head through a gap in the leaves.
I walk a thick branch to the fork.
I lie still on a leaf.

lines.zh: 丛林叶背，我的鳞是亮的。
lines.en: Under a jungle leaf, my scales shine.

lines.zh: 我的颜色很鲜艳，藏不住。
lines.en: My colours are bright; I cannot hide.
I hear something in the leaves.
I puff my throat once.

lines.zh: 这里的湿气贴在我的皮上。
lines.en: The damp clings to my skin.

lines.zh: 头顶的叶子滴着水，我一动不动。
lines.en: Leaves drip overhead; I stay perfectly still.

lines.zh: 我把自己摊平在树皮上。
lines.en: I flatten myself against the bark.
My tail tip twitches.

lines.zh: 树叶落下来，吓了我一跳。
lines.en: A falling leaf startles me.

lines.zh: 我的皮很鲜艳，别靠太近。
lines.en: My skin is bright; do not come close.

lines.zh: 你手上那个袋子，我认得。
lines.en: I know that bag in your hand.
I am in the tree; you are on the ground.
I do not bite people, but I am afraid.
Step back and I will come down.

lines.zh: 你身上有别的爬宠的气味。
lines.en: You smell of other reptiles.

lines.zh: 丛林里能藏的东西太多了。
lines.en: There is plenty to hide in this jungle.

lines.zh: 你也在看我吗？我先眨眼。
lines.en: Looking at me too? I'll blink first.
The pain sends me up the tree.
There is a tear in my skin.
When monsters come, I give one short cry.
I retreat to the far side of the branch.
I lie still and try not to move.
A small piece of my tail is gone.
You are far heavier than me.
I shift up another stretch.
I will still call out.
Bugs? Let me see.
I edge half a step toward the insect.
It is still moving; I want it.
Don't shake it; I cannot aim.
My tongue is quick.
Just put it on the leaf.
I am not fussy; a moth will do.
I snatch it and retreat.
Is there more? I am hungry.

lines.zh: 你撞到树干，我差点掉下来。
lines.en: You hit the trunk and I nearly fell.

lines.zh: 我一下窜到更高的枝上。
lines.en: I dart to a higher branch.

lines.zh: 这一下把你的手撞开了。
lines.en: That knocked your hand aside.
My weight will not move you.
I leap over your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你的脚踩到了我的尾巴尖。
lines.en: Your foot caught my tail tip.

lines.zh: 我贴在树皮上，心跳很快。
lines.en: I press to the bark, heart racing.
Stop shaking the tree.

lines.zh: 我这一身颜色是给别人看的。
lines.en: These colours are for being seen.
That is none of your business.
There are plenty of my kind in the jungle.
I put my head behind a leaf.
Your question stiffened my tail.
I crawl up along the branch.
Right now I must find bugs.
The wet season has not come.
I will not answer you.
There is other work up in the tree.
It still struggles in my mouth.
This is too big to swallow.
It slipped; I picked it up again.
This is today's catch.
Good; I will eat it slowly.
Crawling into your bag still counts as moving house.

lines.zh: 你手心好暖，我趴一会儿。
lines.en: Your palm is warm. I'll rest here a moment.
Easy there — my tail is fragile.
Something nearby sounds wrong.
I start screaming loudly.
I turn that way against the bark.
I scream so others will hear.
I climb to a higher branch.
The jungle birds have all flown.
Its shadow passes under the tree.

lines.zh: 我要让它知道我看见它了。
lines.en: I want it to know I saw it.
My call grows shriller.
This stretch of wood is no longer quiet.
I watch its every move.
It has looked up this way.
I leap to another tree.
Another cry, longer this time.
I move along the branches with it.
Wherever it goes, I call that way.
I change branches and keep watching.
It is much slower than me.

lines.zh: 我贴着树干，尽量不显眼。
lines.en: I press to the trunk, as inconspicuous as I can.

lines.zh: 我的颜色在这一带太亮了。
lines.en: My colours are too bright here.
It looks up to find me.
I call again and retreat.
This branch is not very sound.
It stopped under the tree a while.

lines.zh: 我数着它在落叶上的声音。
lines.en: I count its rustle on the leaf litter.
It is walking out of the wood.
I follow until it is well away.
My calls grow quieter.
It has not quite gone.
Its shadow slowly shrinks.
I climb two more feet up.

lines.zh: 树冠的风把叫声吹散了。
lines.en: The canopy wind thins my call.
One last look.

lines.zh: 我咬住它垂下来的耳尖。
lines.en: I bite the tip of its hanging ear.
It swats and I fly off.

lines.zh: 我落在叶子上，立刻再上。
lines.en: I land on a leaf and climb straight back.
I rake its hand with my claws.

lines.zh: 我只想把它赶出这棵树。
lines.en: I only mean to drive it off this tree.

lines.zh: 它退了一步，退到灌木边。
lines.en: It steps back to the brush.
I dive in from another angle.
Its hide is thicker than bark.
I lash my tail across its face.
It raises a hand; I bite a finger.
It throws me off and I climb high.
I am panting and my heart still races.
I call once more, fiercely.
It climbed down the tree and left.

lines.zh: 我从树上滑下来，慢慢爬。
lines.en: I slide down and crawl slowly.
It is safe here for now.
I hear another sound.

lines.zh: 我出现在丛林的一根枝上。
lines.en: I appear on a jungle branch.

lines.zh: 我的颜色在绿叶里很跳。
lines.en: My colours jump out against the green.
First I look all around.
It is very damp; just right.

lines.zh: 我伸出舌头舔了舔眼睛。
lines.en: I lick my eye with my tongue.
I leap from a leaf to the trunk.
There should be plenty of insects here.
My tail is still soft; I will stay put.

lines.zh: 我先爬到高一点的位置。
lines.en: First I climb a little higher.
This bark is good for gripping.
Good; time to look for food.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的皮，颜色都焦了。
lines.en: Fire scorches my skin and dulls the colour.

lines.zh: 我从枝上掉下去，摔在落叶里。
lines.en: I fall from the branch into the leaves.

lines.zh: 雨水灌进来，我四脚乱划。
lines.en: Rain floods in and my four feet flail.

lines.zh: 气浪把我从树上掀下来。
lines.en: The blast tears me off the tree.

lines.zh: 箭穿过叶子，擦过我的背。
lines.en: An arrow comes through the leaves and grazes my back.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的脚抓不住树。
lines.en: That force loosens my grip on the tree.

lines.zh: 雷光把我的鲜艳皮照白了。
lines.en: The flash bleaches my bright skin.
I fall, four feet grasping at nothing.
